name: MetaShot Smart Cricket
summary: MetaShot is a revolutionary cricket game that brings the physical world into your game. With its patented technology, MetaShot tracks each shot as you play, then recreates them in the game. This means that you can feel the power of every shot, and experience the thrill of a real cricket match right in your living room.
